explanation: Implemented the Apache Commons CLI 1.9.0 core specifications for Option, OptionGroup, Options, CommandLine, and DefaultParser along with the exception hierarchy (ParseException, UnrecognizedOptionException, AmbiguousOptionException, AlreadySelectedException, MissingArgumentException, MissingOptionException) and helpers (OptionValidator, Util). Preserved option cloning, parser reuse, required options tracking, and exact matching logic conforming to the frozen contract.
